shop.jpeg_desc: The most widely supported format. Choose this for printing, social media, or if you're not sure which one you need.

about.title: About us
about.intro: RoadsidePhoto is a Hungarian motorsport photography team: we take dynamic photos and videos of participants at motorcycle, car and cycling events. Our goal is simple — that everyone can easily find and buy the shot of themselves, without needless registration or hassle.
about.step1_desc: Our photographers capture passing motorcycles, cars and bikes in corners, on climbs and technical sections.
about.step2_desc: Photos and videos are uploaded to the gallery as watermarked previews, searchable by time.
about.step3_desc: You find yourself by location and time, check the preview, then buy without registration.
about.step4_desc: After payment you download in JPEG + WebP format, watermark-free, at original resolution — the link lasts 72 hours.
about.photographers_body: Do you regularly shoot in corners, at races or meetups? Join the team: you upload your own events' material, we handle watermarking, the shop and payouts, and you get an agreed percentage of the revenue on every sale.
